title: Loop body machine construction
statement: Given a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine $B$ and a state $a$ of $B$, construct a machine with one additional work tape and states $(q,b)$, where $q$ is a state of $B$ and $b$ is Boolean. Its initial state is $(q_0,\mathrm{false})$. When the state is $(a,\mathrm{false})$, it halts, leaves the input head stationary, leaves the original work tapes unchanged, and writes false on the added tape without moving its head. In every other state, it performs $B$'s transition using the original work tapes; it preserves that action on the input and original work tapes, emits the same output, and, if $B$ halts on that transition, writes true on the added tape while leaving its head stationary. If $B$ continues in state $s$, the new state is $(s,\mathrm{false})$, and the added tape is left unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $B$ over the Boolean alphabet
